title: From Amazon, ABB to Google, AirTrunk & more: Global giants commit billions of dollars to India
summary: Large US technology companies have collectively committed billions of dollars to India, highlighting the country's growing importance as a key destination for cloud computing, artificial intelligence and deep-tech investments.
